source_self_review: All 463 current parent lines and all 63/159/262 control lines read after formatting. Original 430-line owner previously read fully. Negotiated and field-order owners were not changed in this commit.
baseline_scaffolding: counts now exposes TestResult and every existing count caller uses ?, while the original heads().unwrap_or_default() calculation still wraps its successful result. This preserves lost-poison behavior; it is an explicit causal Result seam, not a remedy.

CountingProxy and Origin now expose finish, used by original success callers. It aborts and joins the existing listener only, accepts cancellation, and leaves accepted handlers detached with discarded results. This changes listener return-time ownership and can surface listener panic/join/deadline failures; original Drop only requested abort. Success equivalence and original wire assertions are retained, but this is not byte-identical old lifecycle behavior.

The original Origin one-connection body is extracted into serve_origin with the same accept, read_head, poisoned-writer skip, 200/body, Connection: close and shutdown behavior. Its supervisor still discards spawned handles.
No existing wire/capture/credential assertion was deleted. Existing four tests remain; count expression changes only add Result propagation. No ordinary origin was changed to keep-alive.
